profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | BVLOS / UAS / C2 | Simulation & Distributed Systems for Aerospace
profile.summary:
I build Command & Control (C2) systems for UAS (drone) operations, with a focus on BVLOS flight and Part 108 regulatory compliance — spanning backend architecture, full-stack development, and secure cloud deployment (DevSecOps).
 
That work sits on top of 15+ years designing, building, and deploying complex technical systems across aerospace, defense, simulation, and cloud infrastructure — including software architecture, high-fidelity simulation, flight dynamics, and distributed systems. I work primarily in C/C++, Python, Go, and TypeScript, across cloud platforms and containerized environments.
 
With a background in both aerospace and computer engineering, I bring a systems-level view to problems that span hardware constraints, software architecture, and real-world operational rules — the kind of work where the regulatory environment matters as much as the code.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Design and build a Command & Control (C2) system for UAS operations, using Go for backend services and TypeScript/React for the operator-facing frontend, deployed on AWS
 
• Develop software supporting BVLOS (Beyond Visual Line of Sight) operations and Part 108 regulatory compliance, contributing to FAA-aligned flight operation capabilities
 
• Own full-stack and DevSecOps responsibilities — from backend service architecture and cloud infrastructure (AWS) to CI/CD pipelines and security-conscious deployment practices
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Go (Programming Language) · Claude Code · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and built a Hardware in the Loop Simulation Framework solution using Protobuf, Python, C/C++, and a Real Time Operating System Data Acquisition platform.

• Implemented a distributed simulation framework to be used by model developers using Protobufs, C/C++ 17 standard, and Python.

• Led software best practices and DevOps effort among my peers in an inter-department coloration.
positions.insights: Skills: C/C++ · Simulations · DevSecOps · Software Architecture · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Cloud Platform Software Engineer - Senior Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
• Maintained the Wind River Cloud Platform using Python, FluxCD, Ansible, Puppet, and Kubernetes.
• Contributed to the open source StarlingX project and Technical Steering Committee.
• Provided technical leadership to product team leaders across all product domains.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Interpersonal Skills · Python (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · FluxCD · Helm

positions.title: Sr. Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Supported disparate teams across the enterprise by assessing software 
development and deployment strategies and working to implement 
optimizations for cost and schedule savings. 

• Coached dozens of different teams to adopt DevOps tools and practices and 
brought an estimated value of $15 Million cost savings to the enterprise. 

• Built Jenkins continuous integration pipelines for dozens of different 
applications, including C++, Python, Java, FPGA, and containerized 
pipelines.

• Developed DevOps training material and administered it on an enterprise 
scale to a company with over 90,000 employees.

• Optimized a machine learning python application by minimizing memory 
consumption and improving execution speed by twenty times using multi-threading and profiling techniques

positions.title: Sr. Principal System Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and built a full stack web application experience using 
Microservices, Docker, Docker Swarm, MySQL, MongoDB, and Python for 
purpose of automating large scale simulations on a High-Performance 
Cluster using Slurm. 

• Maintained production system and updated it using continuous deployment 
strategies. 

• Designed and built a secure REST API backend with Python and JWT so 
power users could interface with a web application without having to use web 
interface. 

• Built automated DevOps pipelines to evaluate and verify simulation code and 
package deliverables to customer with Python and Jenkins.

positions.title: Principal Systems Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of twenty-five engineers to develop a C/C++ radar simulation 
digital twin.

• Engaged customer on daily basis and reported weekly status to program 
management.

• Analyzed team performance and measured earned value metrics.

• Developed a dynamic IQ radar simulation framework, built radar-related 
models in python and C/C++, and built a data-type agnostic data logger in 
C/C/++.

• Created executable work plans and developed staffing plans.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Organized with researchers at NASA Langley Researcher Center in the 
Simulation Development and Analysis Branch to build flight simulation 
scenarios for dozens of experiments.

• Gained experience with real-time embedded systems, simulation 
frameworks, software development practices, hardware interfaces, and 
object-oriented design in C/C++.

• Led a team of six as Scrum Master using the AGILE Scrum software 
development process.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Interpersonal Skills · Configuration Management · Test Automation · Problem Solving · C/C++ · Embedded Systems · VxWorks

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Invented a method for simulating ADS-B traffic with a satellite internet backbone and developed a proof of concept using C/C++.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Interpersonal Skills · Configuration Management · Problem Solving

positions.title: IT & Project Manager
positions.description:
• Organized the IT infrastructure for a company of 20-30 people.

• Projected and tracked earned value for all company projects.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The National Museum of WWII Aviation
volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteer about 4 hours a week to mentor a group of 16-20 engineering interns whom are building various interactive exhibits. These exhibits are essentially simulators built into existing displays, such as a B-25 Cockpit, a Norden Bombsight, and a Link Trainer.  My mentorship is aimed at acting as an internal customer and prompting the interns to think of things that would be expected in a professional setting, such as documentation and project planning/reporting activities.  I also offer technical expertise to anyone in need of it.

company.name: The National Museum of WWII Aviation

volunteerExperiences.description: I really love being around the horses and I wanted to make a difference in a non-technical field, so I found a nearby Equine Rescue to help out at.  I do all the things you'd expect to do taking care of horses.  The work is very humbling and the other volunteers are amazing people.

projects.title: Agents of The System
projects.description: A cloud based Video Game Server Manager with a focus on friend groups.  This is a personal project that I am working on to keep my skills sharp, to help my friends, run how to run an open source project, and gain AWS experience.

projects.title: DeepNado
projects.description: For fun, I am working with a friend to use old GPU equipment around my home to use an open source dataset and teach myself how to do some basic supervised learning using Python PyTorch.

publications.title: Proof-of-Concept of a Networked Validation Environment for Distributed Air/Ground NextGen Concepts
publications.publisher: 2013 Aviation Technology, Integration, and Operations (ATIO) Conference · Jul 12, 2013
